## Checklist

- [ ] Follows [STYLE.md](../STYLE.md): plain language, sentences of 30 words or fewer, terms in the glossary.
- [ ] Every new figure or claim has a primary source and a date; anything unverified is recorded in PLAN.md.

- [ ] Diagrams changed? Re-rendered with `python3 scripts/diagrams.py render` and committed the `.svg` and `images/.hashes.json`.
